newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds drift lower in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds drift lower in thin trade.

text.p: Trading on the UK meals and feeds market was slow on Monday with most players sidelined by the U.S. holiday.
"Chicago is closed and it's providing a good excuse for people to do nothing," said one broker.
However, brokers were able to report a few trades, but said there was little volume behind them.
EU sunflower meal fetched 94 stg a tonne for spot and 87 stg for Apl ex-store Teignmouth.
Argentine cottonseed pellets traded at 122 stg for spot ex-store Southampton.
High protein soymeal sellers were lower with nearby positions one stg down while forwards were two stg lower.
